title: Roof repair, replacement and new roofs for private homes in Georgia
phrase: We assess the roof, find weak points, propose options and carry out the work.
text: We work with existing roofs and build new roofs for houses, extensions and canopies. We assess rafters, support on walls, old covering and moisture, then repair, replace or build the required structure.
caseTitle: Roof replacement on an old house
caseText: The practical task was to stop water damaging an old house. The old roof was removed, the rafter system was replaced and the house was covered with profiled sheet metal.
situations: The roof leaks and the house is beginning to deteriorate.
A complete rafter-system replacement is needed.
The roof is the first stage of a larger reconstruction.
The covering needs replacement but the condition of the rafters is unclear.
You are building a house or extension and need a new roof.
checkTitle: We assess the roof, find weak points and propose options
checkText: We inspect rafters, wall support, the old covering, moisture, rot, eaves and junctions. After inspection we propose repair, replacement of damaged timber or a new rafter system.
scope: profiled sheet metal or another suitable material
eaves, junctions and drainage when included in the scope
faq: Can the price be understood from photos?
Photos help identify the task. The exact scope and price follow inspection.
Can only the covering be replaced?
Yes, when the timber structure is sound enough for the new covering.
Do you build new rafter systems?
Yes. The solution is chosen after inspection of the roof and wall support.
formText: Send a few photos, the location and a short description of the task.
